message: The other night, we had a little scare when the power went out unexpectedly. Instead of panicking, I grabbed our go-bags and set up a cozy camp in the living room with blankets and flashlights. It turned into a family adventure, complete with storytelling and even some snacks we had stashed away. 🌟 I realized that being prepared doesn’t just mean having supplies ready; it can also create sweet moments together. What’s your favorite way to turn a tricky situation into a cozy family event?
